online_information_boundary: This is retrospective only: labels are opened after all six frozen cue traces and prediction files pass their recorded hashes. No tracker output, feature bank, proposal graph or threshold is changed.
scope: Measure unknown/NULL support, legal candidate competition and duplicate same-identity proposals in the already accepted native DINO384/FIFO traces. This does not fit a rule or claim an online gain.
decision_gate: Use the measurements to specify a future unknown-preserving set/NULL rule only if support is present across all six videos; do not launch a replay from this descriptive audit alone.
